# HELP embyfin_devices How many devices the server knows of, which is every one it has ever seen.
# TYPE embyfin_devices gauge
embyfin_devices{server="emby"} 7
# HELP embyfin_devices_active Devices seen within the window: the last day, 7 days or 30 days.
# TYPE embyfin_devices_active gauge
embyfin_devices_active{server="emby",window="1d"} 1
embyfin_devices_active{server="emby",window="30d"} 3
embyfin_devices_active{server="emby",window="7d"} 2
